rows.my_view: Fair price below the $285 base, with upside if a free-cash-flow machine emerges from the capex build.
rows.committee: Fair not cheap at 14.4x EV/EBITDA and 29x GAAP, but every DCF value silently assumes an FCF recovery the enriched data flags as currently unverifiable.

rows.my_view: Still compounding with more upside than the market appreciates.
rows.committee: Confirmed and stronger than framed — the latest quarter reaccelerated to +17% versus the +11% five-year CAGR at a $742B base.

rows.my_view: Retail improving, ads high-margin, operating leverage coming.
rows.committee: Confirmed — operating margin went 5% to 12-13% with Q1 at 13%, a genuine transformation at massive scale.

rows.my_view: One of the highest-quality, most durable businesses on earth.
rows.committee: Strong — four self-reinforcing moats no rival can copy across all fronts, though the flywheel now leans on record capex proving it compounds rather than merely defends.

rows.my_view: A maturing FCF era where capex should convert to cash.
rows.committee: Reframed — TTM capex ($151B) has crossed above operating cash flow ($148.5B) for the first time, so the build is now partly debt-financed and normalization is unproven.

rows.my_view: Full credit is already priced in, the 'wait if' condition.
rows.committee: Timing and dead-money risk plus a debt-financed build — even flawless execution can produce years of sideways return while the owner's own FCF rule (-$2.47B TTM) is failing.

The owner's claimed edge — underwriting segment by segment — is impossible here because AWS growth, ad revenue, and segment margins are entirely absent, so the core thesis is literally unresolvable today and rests on faith until July 30.

rows.my_view: AWS, ads, and margin all compounding at once.
rows.committee: AWS revenue growth on the July 30 print — 20%+ and leading Azure/Google means the capex is investment; sub-15% and trailing means it is a defense bill.

confidence.label: Moderate
confidence.why: The business-quality half of the thesis is elite and well-evidenced, but the FCF-compounder half rests entirely on segment data absent from the packet until July 30.

final_verdict: Elite business at a fair price survives scrutiny as a patience bet, but the 'overlooked FCF compounder' framing must be dropped and July 30 must earn the open call.
